description: Batch form of get_related — the connections of SEVERAL articles in one call (max 8). Use when mapping a whole legal institution rather than a single provision. Pass a list of {law, article}.

law.description: The act, however it is at hand: a citation ('Legea 265/2022', 'HG 1/2016', 'Ordinul 2594/C/2008'), a common name ('Codul fiscal'), a title any tool printed, or 'normele de aplicare a Legii X'.

name: get_related_batch
